free.label: Free
free.subtitle: In-house
free.tagline: Our own 3D engine. Zero per-reel render cost.
free.summary: Declarative 3D scenes (three.js), real physics simulation, KaTeX maths, synced neural voice and captions. Runs on your machine; only the script LLM call costs anything.
highlights: Physics simulator checked against textbook formulas
Layout lint and vision QA with one auto-retry
Best for physics, chemistry and maths

premium.label: Premium
premium.subtitle: Generated imagery with camera moves
premium.tagline: Generated imagery for history, civics and biology.
premium.summary: Generated stills with in-house camera moves and depth, archival photo fallback, source-checked facts, and a premium narration voice. A hard spend cap is enforced before every paid call.
highlights: Generated stills with slow camera moves
Archival photo fallback when the cap or a provider says no
Hard spend cap enforced before every call

premium_video.label: Premium Video
premium_video.subtitle: Generated stills + real video clips
premium_video.tagline: Everything in Premium, with real generated video on the beats that need motion.
premium_video.summary: Premium's stills, voice and fact checks, plus a few short generated video clips on the beats where motion teaches. Each clip starts from an image the reviewer already accepted, is checked for drift, and falls back to the still with a camera move if anything goes wrong. A hard spend cap is enforced before every paid call.
highlights: Real generated video clips on the key beats
Every clip starts from a reviewed still and is checked for drift
Falls back to a still with a camera move, never fails the reel
Premium voice, source-checked facts, archival photos
Hard spend cap enforced before every call

ultra.label: Ultra
ultra.subtitle: Cinematic
ultra.tagline: Full cinematic generation. Not being built yet.
ultra.summary: Reserved for a later phase once Free and Premium are solid.
highlights: Scope and pricing to be decided
